description: Test your human intuition in Mentirosa, a fast-paced language game where you distinguish AI-generated phrases from human ones. Each round presents two phrases—tap the one you think an AI wrote before time runs out. Build your streak, climb the leaderboard, and see if you can outsmart the machine.
